messages:
Ravi: Heads-up
round next quarter: I'm relocating from Berlin to SF with an official start in the US office on 2026-12-15. How does the year-end shutdown/blackout apply when I'm crossing regions mid-period? Will my PTO accrual or carryover be pro-rated?
Sam - People Ops: Congrats on the move! Short answer: blackout rules and regional public holidays are applied based on your employment location on each payroll cut-off. For the year-end shutdown, we'll apply the policy for the country where you're employed on the shutdown dates.
Ravi: So if I'm technically on the German payroll until 12/14 and on US payroll from 12/15, the shutdown that runs 12/24-1/2 would be covered by which region?
Marta (EMEA HR): Since your employment contract change takes effect 12/15, payroll and benefits team will split the period. The shutdown span will mostly fall under US payroll in your case. We'll need the formal transfer docs so we can map the blackout and statutory holidays correctly.
Sam - People Ops: Policy detail: "Carryover and accruals are pro-rated by active employment days per jurisdiction during the accrual period. Blackout exemptions and company shutdown protections follow the payroll jurisdiction covering the shutdown dates." We'll pro-rate your accruals for the month of transfer.
Jordan (Eng Manager): I can confirm coverage for your deliverables during the transfer week. If you want to take a few travel days, book them as PTO now and mark them tentative; People Ops can adjust after transfer docs are provided.
Ravi: What about public holiday differences? Germany has Dec 24 as a partial day culture but US has federal holidays. Will I lose any days?
Marta (EMEA HR): We'll map statutory holidays to your local schedule. If the transfer causes you to miss holidays you would have otherwise observed, we'll either credit equivalent days or adjust carryover so you aren't disadvantaged. Please upload the relocation/assignment paperwork to HR portal.
people-ops-bot: Ticket created: PO-7890. Upload received: transfer_agreement.pdf. People Ops will review and confirm within 2 business days.
Sam - People Ops: Once we verify, we'll send a summary email showing: 1) pro-rated accruals for Dec, 2) which shutdown dates will be protected, 3) any holiday credits. If you want interim certainty, request tentative PTO for travel days and we'll hold approval.
Ravi: Uploaded the signed transfer agreement. Thanks all, appreciate the clarity.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Happy to approve tentative PTO so calendars look right. Ping me when you submit it.
